title: 亡灵王子

sync.scope: Source statistics tables and available 2026 history; base values

facts: The Minion Prince is an aerial Hero who attacks all targets from long range that was introduced on November 25, 2024, with the Town Hall 17 update. He is unlocked by upgrading the Hero Hall to level 3, which requires Town Hall 9.
Upgrading the Blacksmith to level 3 and 5 unlocks the Metal Pants and Noble Iron respectively.

The Dark Crown passively buffs the Minion Prince's damage and max health as every 60 housing space worth of friendly units die, up to three times. It gives a passive increase to max health and attack speed.
